description: Experience direction manifest for the local Laya decision engine. Same entry shape as the component catalog (id/name/description/use_case/search_tags) plus kind-specific fields. Facts come from here; Laya only scores semantic fit.

entry_schema.kind: archetype | philosophy | style | page-type | navigation-model | question

entries.name: Explainer
entries.description: Explain something complex with clarity.
entries.use_case: Choose when the user must understand before acting; progressive explanation, diagrams and narrative.

entries.name: Converter
entries.description: Drive one clear action with trust and low friction.
entries.use_case: Landing pages, campaigns, sign-up or demo requests where a single conversion matters.

entries.name: Explorer
entries.description: Let people discover content they did not know they wanted.
entries.use_case: Catalogs, media, knowledge bases with many entities and lateral exploration.

entries.name: Operator
entries.description: Support frequent task execution with speed and control.
entries.use_case: Dashboards, admin panels and tools used daily by professionals.

entries.name: Configurator
entries.description: Let the user choose and personalize with a live preview.
entries.use_case: Product configurators, pricing builders, integration wizards.

entries.name: Comparator
entries.description: Help choose between alternatives with evidence.
entries.use_case: Pricing comparisons, product matrices, plan selection.

entries.name: Educator
entries.description: Teach step by step with visible progress.
entries.use_case: Courses, tutorials, onboarding academies, guided setup.

entries.name: Reference
entries.description: Consult information with precision and speed.
entries.use_case: Documentation, knowledge bases, API references, guides.

entries.name: Storyteller
entries.description: Create a memorable narrative experience.
entries.use_case: Launches, brand moments, product stories, portfolios.

entries.name: Community
entries.description: Create value through participation.

entries.name: Marketplace
entries.description: Find, evaluate and choose among many listings.

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description: Watch state and changes with control.
entries.use_case: Observability, operations, support consoles, IoT gateways.

entries.name: Workflow
entries.description: Complete a process calmly, step by step.

entries.name: Portfolio
entries.description: Prove capability through the work itself.

entries.name: Editorial
entries.description: Read and explore ideas through typographic rhythm.

entries.name: Functional clarity
entries.description: Understand and act with minimal effort.
entries.use_case: Tools, docs and high-frequency interfaces where confusion is costly.
entries.structure: obvious hierarchy, one primary action per screen

entries.name: Operational efficiency
entries.description: Do frequent tasks fast.

entries.name: Discovery
entries.description: Find things you did not know you wanted.

entries.name: Trust and authority
entries.description: Be believed through evidence.
entries.use_case: High-price or complex offers, regulated domains.

entries.name: Narrative and emotion
entries.description: Make the experience memorable.

entries.name: Transparency
entries.description: Show exactly what happens, when and why.

entries.name: Professional control
entries.description: Expert users feel in command.

entries.name: Progressive simplicity
entries.description: Reveal complexity only when needed.
entries.use_case: Products that must serve novices and experts.

entries.name: Personalization
entries.description: Adapt to the person or context.
entries.use_case: Platforms with user data and repeated sessions.

entries.name: Technical depth
entries.description: Be precise and verifiable for technical users.

entries.name: Community
entries.description: Belonging and contribution.

entries.name: Conversion without friction
entries.description: One clear yes with no competing actions.

entries.name: Visual exploration
entries.description: Let the work or content speak first.

entries.name: Editorial
entries.description: Reading as an experience.

entries.name: Experimental (controlled)
entries.description: Be different without being confusing.
entries.structure: one unusual idea anchored in familiar rest

entries.name: Minimalist functional
entries.description: Whitespace, one typeface, one accent, a single speaking CTA.
entries.fits_when: the product is used often and clarity wins
entries.avoid_when: the brand needs warmth or spectacle
risks: anonymous if spacing/type craft is weak

entries.name: Editorial
entries.description: Magazine typography: serif headings, sans body, generous grid.
entries.use_case: Content, stories, brands with a voice.
risks: needs real typographic skill and content

entries.name: Swiss / typographic grid
entries.description: Rigorous grid, strong type hierarchy, restrained color.
entries.fits_when: order and precision are the message

entries.name: Brutalism
entries.description: Raw structure exposed: mono fonts, hard borders, zero decoration.

entries.name: Neubrutalism
entries.description: Bold colors, thick black borders, hard shadows, no radii.

entries.name: Bento grid
entries.description: Modular compartments of varied sizes in one grid.
entries.fits_when: content can be atomized into meaningful blocks
entries.avoid_when: there is no hierarchy to encode

entries.name: Glassmorphism
entries.description: Frosted translucent panels over colorful backdrops.
entries.use_case: Dark heroes, overlays, modern tech feel.

entries.name: Neumorphism
entries.description: Soft molded surfaces with dual shadows.
entries.use_case: Small widgets, playful demos, audio controls.
entries.fits_when: the interface is simple and light

entries.name: Claymorphism
entries.description: Inflated clay shapes with pastel fills.

entries.name: Maximalism
entries.description: Rich, layered, expressive composition.
entries.fits_when: abundance is part of the message

entries.name: Retro / Y2K
entries.description: Beveled chrome, scanlines, starfields, nostalgic UI.

entries.name: Terminal / developer
entries.description: Monospace, command-line aesthetics, density with precision.
entries.use_case: Dev tools, APIs, dashboards, AI consoles.

entries.name: Industrial / technical
entries.description: Rugged, reliable, state-first control surfaces.
entries.fits_when: operators need status at a glance

entries.name: Data-dense
entries.description: High information density with strict typographic hierarchy.

entries.name: Luxury / premium
entries.description: Restrained layouts, refined type, generous negative space.
entries.fits_when: exclusivity and craft are the promise

entries.name: Organic / natural
entries.description: Warm colors, soft shapes, human imagery.

entries.name: Playful / friendly
entries.description: Rounded, colorful, expressive microcopy and illustrations.

entries.name: Dark technical
entries.description: Designed dark system: surface tiers, off-white text, desaturated accents.
entries.avoid_when: daylight, low-quality screens or print-like reading
risks: not a simple inversion; contrast discipline required

entries.name: Home
entries.description: Entry point that sets the pace and routes to the main jobs.
entries.use_case: All sites; adapts logged-in/out and archetype.
entries.primary_action: depends on archetype (start, search, browse, sign up)

entries.name: Landing
entries.description: One message, one action, zero distractions.

entries.name: Product detail
entries.description: Clear the path to decision: media, specs, price, CTA.
entries.states: out of stock, price change, variants

entries.name: Search results
entries.description: Keep the query visible, reassure and reveal relevant results.

entries.name: Registration / auth
entries.description: Fast, unobtrusive commitment with fallback options.

entries.name: Article / long-form
entries.description: Hold attention with rhythm, hierarchy and spacing.

entries.name: Dashboard
entries.description: Personal metrics and status for repeated use.
entries.primary_action: act on the most urgent signal

entries.name: Catalog / listing
entries.description: Browse and filter a collection with ranking.

entries.name: Configurator
entries.description: Choose options with a live preview and clear consequences.

entries.name: Cart / checkout
entries.description: Confirm choices and reduce hesitation until completion.
entries.states: payment failure, out of stock, saved cart

entries.name: Documentation / reference
entries.description: Precise lookup with in-page navigation and cross-links.

entries.name: Profile / settings
entries.description: Manage account, preferences and data with clear consequences.

entries.name: Error / 404
entries.description: Recovery surface: reorient instead of apologizing.

entries.name: Contact / lead
entries.description: Frictionless reach-out that reinforces trust.

entries.name: Stats / analytics
entries.description: Turn data into a personal, scannable story.

entries.name: Pricing
entries.description: Make the choice obvious without hiding costs.

entries.name: Single-page anchors
entries.description: One scrolling page with anchored sections and an in-page menu.
entries.layout: vertical spine of section nodes with labeled anchors

entries.name: Linear / wizard
entries.description: Step-by-step guided completion with branches.
entries.layout: left-to-right steps with decision diamonds and dashed optional paths

entries.name: Hub
entries.description: A central surface routes to clusters of related content or tools.
entries.layout: start node plus clusters by area in columns
entries.fits_when: several areas share one entry point

entries.name: Catalog
entries.description: Discovery loop: search/browse, compare, select, transact, return.
entries.layout: discovery → decision → transaction areas with return loops

entries.name: Console
entries.description: Persistent shell with modules, panels and states.
entries.layout: modules/panels by area with persistent navigation

entries.name: Tree
entries.description: Hierarchical site with depth by section and breadcrumbs.

entries.name: What are we building?
entries.description: What are we building?
entries.use_case: Phase 1 context; unlocks product shape and archetype questions.

entries.name: Who uses it?
entries.description: Who uses it?
entries.use_case: Phase 1 audience; unlocks philosophy and density questions.

entries.name: Main goal of the site?
entries.description: Main goal of the site?
entries.use_case: Phase 1; unlocks success metric and archetype.

entries.name: What action proves success?
entries.description: What action proves success?
entries.use_case: Phase 1; anchors measurement and primary action.

entries.name: How often will they use it?
entries.description: How often will they use it?
entries.use_case: Phase 1; decides density, onboarding and shell.

entries.name: Starting point?
entries.description: Starting point?
entries.use_case: Phase 1; decides from-scratch vs redesign path.

entries.name: Fast and direct, or exploratory and memorable?
entries.description: Fast and direct, or exploratory and memorable?
entries.use_case: Phase 2 philosophy; feeds Laya direction ranking.

entries.name: What should the experience prioritize?
entries.description: What should the experience prioritize?

entries.name: What should it feel like?
entries.description: What should it feel like?

entries.name: Understand in seconds, or discover gradually?
entries.description: Understand in seconds, or discover gradually?

entries.name: Conventional or experimental?
entries.description: Conventional or experimental?
entries.use_case: Phase 2; risk appetite of the direction.

entries.name: Brand personality?
entries.description: Brand personality?

entries.name: How many main areas?
entries.description: How many main areas?

entries.name: Guided order or free exploration?
entries.description: Must users follow an order, or explore freely?

entries.name: Is there a dominant task?
entries.description: Is there a dominant task that should own the interface?

entries.name: How should content be organized?
entries.description: How should content be organized?

entries.name: Will they search, filter or compare?
entries.description: Will they search, filter or compare?
entries.use_case: Phase 3; search/filter patterns and map loops.

entries.name: Do they need save/resume/history?
entries.description: Do they need save/resume/history?

entries.name: Explain a proposal or do a task?
entries.description: Does the main page explain a proposal or let them do a task?

entries.name: Closest shape?
entries.description: Closest shape?
entries.use_case: Phase 4; strong archetype signal for Laya.

entries.name: What will they mostly do?
entries.description: What will they mostly do?

entries.name: Linear or non-linear journey?
entries.description: Linear or non-linear journey?

entries.name: Does it show live state, alerts or progress?
entries.description: Does it show live state, alerts or progress?

entries.name: Content or interaction dominant?
entries.description: What dominates: content or interaction?

entries.name: How bold should the proposals be?
entries.description: How bold should the proposals be?
entries.use_case: Phase 5 creative control; unlocks familiarity and motion.

entries.name: Anything to avoid?
entries.description: Anything to avoid?
entries.use_case: Phase 5; anti-generic list for the brief.

entries.name: Avoid the classic hero + 3 cards + testimonials?
entries.description: Avoid the classic hero + 3 cards + testimonials?

entries.name: Acceptable motion level?
entries.description: Acceptable motion level?
entries.use_case: Phase 5; motion budget for the brief.

entries.name: Where should creativity live?
entries.description: Where should creativity live?
entries.use_case: Phase 5; axis for the three directions.

entries.name: What must not change?
entries.description: What must not change across proposals?

entries.name: Priority devices?
entries.description: Priority devices?

entries.name: Accessibility needs beyond WCAG AA?
entries.description: Accessibility needs beyond WCAG AA?

entries.name: Offline or poor connectivity?
entries.description: Offline or poor connectivity?

entries.name: Special environment?
entries.description: Special environment?
entries.use_case: Phase 6; touch, gloves, kiosk, low light.

entries.name: WCAG target?
entries.description: WCAG target?

entries.name: Biggest constraint?
entries.description: Biggest constraint?

entries.name: Liquid glass
entries.description: Translucent layered surfaces with soft refraction and fluid shading.
entries.use_case: Overlays, media-led apps, premium consumer products on Apple-like platforms.
entries.fits_when: content is visual and sits behind controls
risks: looks dated if copied without purpose

entries.name: Kinetic typography
entries.description: Variable fonts and type that move with scroll or pointer; type is the identity.
entries.use_case: Brand sites, campaigns, portfolios, editorial openers.
entries.fits_when: the message is short and the brand has a voice

entries.name: Hand-drawn / sketch
entries.description: Scribbles, rough illustration and handwritten accents that signal human authorship.
entries.use_case: Creative tools, education, indie products, explainers.

entries.name: Anti-design
entries.description: Deliberately raw, unpolished layouts that break grid and polish conventions.
entries.use_case: Culture, art, music, statements, memorable launches.
entries.fits_when: standing out matters more than efficiency

entries.name: Tactile / soft skeuomorphism
entries.description: Physical-feeling buttons, textures and shadows with real affordance.
entries.use_case: Audio and creative tools, hardware companions, playful consumer apps.

entries.name: Monochrome bold type
entries.description: One colour, oversized headlines and strict spacing; type and layout carry the design.
entries.use_case: Studios, portfolios, product launches, editorial pages.
entries.fits_when: the copy is strong and the brand is confident

entries.name: Assistant
entries.description: Converse with or delegate to an AI that acts on the user's behalf.
entries.use_case: Copilots, agent consoles, support bots, search with generated answers.
risks: chat used where a form is better

entries.name: Activator
entries.description: Take a new user to their first success quickly.
entries.use_case: Onboarding, trials, empty-state-led first run, setup wizards.
risks: asking for too much data up front

entries.name: Scheduler
entries.description: Pick a time, slot or resource and confirm it.
risks: no clear confirmation or cancellation path

entries.name: Onboarding / first run
entries.description: Guided first session that leads to the first success.
entries.use_case: Apps and tools with a setup step.

entries.name: Chat / assistant
entries.description: Conversation surface with input, streaming output, sources and actions.
entries.use_case: AI features inside a product or as the product.
entries.job: get help or delegate a task
entries.states: empty, streaming, error, stopped, needs confirmation

entries.name: Sign in / account access
entries.description: Login, sign-up and recovery without cognitive tests.

entries.name: Plan comparison
entries.description: Compare plans with honest totals and a reversible choice.
entries.use_case: SaaS and subscriptions (extends the pricing page).

entries.name: Consent and privacy
entries.description: Cookie, data and permission requests with equal-weight choices.
entries.use_case: Sites and apps that process personal data.

entries.name: Empty / zero state
entries.description: Explains why nothing is shown and offers the next action.

entries.name: Does the product include AI features?
entries.description: Does the product include AI features?
entries.use_case: Phase 6; triggers the Assistant archetype and Shape of AI patterns.

entries.name: Languages and regions?
entries.description: Languages and regions?
entries.use_case: Phase 6; text expansion, RTL and date/number formats.

entries.name: Performance budget?
entries.description: Performance budget?

entries.name: Light, dark or both?
entries.description: Light, dark or both?
entries.use_case: Phase 6; token structure and contrast checks.

entries.name: Personal data, payments or regulation involved?
entries.description: Personal data, payments or regulation involved?
entries.use_case: Phase 6; consent page, trust signals and deceptive-pattern audit.

entries.name: Do real content and brand assets exist?
entries.description: Do real content and brand assets exist?
entries.use_case: Phase 1; avoids fake testimonials, metrics and logos.
